title: Jelly Roll Morton's last years and his fifteen-piece band in Los Angeles
summary: Morton came west sick and organised a fifteen-piece band with his own arrangements; he fell ill with heart trouble.

story.theme_name: Illness, injury and the deaths of colleagues
story.community_name: Illness, injury and death among jazz musicians
